title: FALL WELLNESS FESTIVAL x HORSES
description: A fall wellness festival with Pilates, yoga, booty sculpt, sound bath, sauna, cold plunge, horses, DJ, vendors + more.
long_description:
A fall wellness festival with Pilates, yoga, booty sculpt, sound bath, sauna, cold plunge, horses, DJ, vendors + more.

About this Event

Spend the day with us at Connecticut’s Fall Wellness Festival, a curated day of movement, wellness, recovery, shopping, and community at Silver Brook Farm in Uncasville, CT.
Surrounded by horses and beautiful fall scenery, you’ll experience a full lineup of wellness classes including Mat Pilates with Mia from Pilatte, Vinyasa Yoga with Shae, Booty Sculpt with Lori-Ann from Body Construct, and a relaxing Sound Bath with Jasmine.
Between classes, explore everything the festival has to offer. Experience the sauna + cold plunge, shop from wellness, beauty, and lifestyle vendors, enjoy food + drink vendors, discover brand activations, listen to our live DJ, spend time around the horses, and connect with an amazing community of women.
Classes are intentionally spaced throughout the day, giving you plenty of time to shop, eat, sip, explore, recover, and connect without feeling rushed.

WHAT TO WEAR + BRING🤎 Dress Code: Wear your favorite workout set in any shade of brown. Think chocolate, espresso, mocha, caramel, tan, or beige.
Please bring a water bottle, towel, change of clothes, and slides or sandals if you plan to enjoy the sauna + cold plunge. We also recommend bringing a swimsuit.
No workout mat needed. Mats will be provided for use during the event. Please do not take the mats home.
October 17 | 11 AM–4 PM
Check-in begins at 10:30 AM
Silver Brook Farm | Uncasville, CT
Come ready to move, reset, shop, sip + connect. 🍂
